mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story (name, core_idea, initial_stage_direction, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{coreIdea}, #{initialStageDirection}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'))
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, core_idea, initial_stage_direction, status, created_at, updated_at FROM story WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, core_idea, initial_stage_direction, status, created_at, updated_at FROM story ORDER BY created_at DESC
